applied.description: finding ids for which a change landed in a commit

failed.description: finding ids for which no change could be made — a denied write, code that no longer exists — each with the reason

base.description: the full 40-character SHA of HEAD before the first fix commit (git rev-parse HEAD after applying, before committing); empty when nothing was applied

commits.description: the full 40-character SHAs of the fix commits package-commit made, oldest first; empty when nothing was applied
